create_time.Description: Creation timestamp in RFC 3339 text format.

description.Description: An optional description of the endpoint.

endpoint_forwarding_rule.Description: URL of the endpoint's network address to which traffic is to be sent by Packet Mirroring.

endpoint_ip.Description: Internal IP address of the endpoint's network entry point.

name.Description: Name of the endpoint in the format projects/{project_id}/locations/{locationId}/endpoints/{endpointId}.

network.Description: Name of the VPC network that is connected to the IDS endpoint. This can either contain the VPC network name itself (like "src-net") or the full URL to the network (like "projects/{project_id}/global/networks/src-net").

severity.Description: The minimum alert severity level that is reported by the endpoint. Possible values: ["INFORMATIONAL", "LOW", "MEDIUM", "HIGH", "CRITICAL"]

threat_exceptions.Description: Configuration for threat IDs excluded from generating alerts. Limit: 99 IDs.

update_time.Description: Last update timestamp in RFC 3339 text format.
